text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just before running in the Leopard Stakes. 
Hokko Tarumae seems to be nervous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are many voices supporting her on 
social media. However, she deliberately 
chooses not to look at them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to show the people of Tomakomai 
how strong she was. She resolved to fight 
using only her own strength.
